verdict.better_or_different: BETTER, on musicdiff's own account, but not free
verdict.why_better: AllObjects ignores chords entirely and forces every pitch error to cost two edits (ins+del) instead of one. On orchestral music — divisi, double stops, condensed staves — ignoring chords is a large omission, and the doubled charge inflates `wrong note` and pushes bars past the point where elementwise pairing is cheaper than whole-bar replacement, which is what feeds `entire measure insert/delete`.
verdict.why_not_free: the denominator moves as well as the numerator; and the structural FLOOR would have to be re-measured, because it is entire-staff charge over (truth+pred) symbols and all three terms change.
verdict.is_it_a_new_era: YES, and a worse-behaved one than a corpus change. A corpus change is visible — the row set differs. A detail-level change re-reads the SAME files and returns a plausible smaller number with every other field identical. It is the discontinuity most likely to be mistaken for progress.
verdict.recommendation: Do not switch the standing gate. Report both columns for one era, with the second stamped as a separate era key, and let Sean decide on evidence rather than on a single better-looking number.
